name: Santiz (Spain)
description: Square flag vertically divided green and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Santiz (a crozier and a Maltese cross on green, a fox on red).
history: The flag of Santiz is square, of proportions 1:1, parted green at the hoist and red at the fly, charged with the municipal arms at the centre, of height 1/3 of the height of the flag.

features.role: Santiz arms — crozier and Maltese cross on green, fox on red
